subject: bearded vulture
title: This Vulture Eats Almost Nothing but Bones, and Swallows Them Whole

scenes.text: One bird lives on a diet that's almost all bone.
The bearded vulture eats what every other scavenger leaves behind: the skeleton.
Up to ninety percent of everything it eats is bone.
Bones too big to swallow, it carries into the sky and drops onto rocks, from as high as a hundred metres.
Then it swallows the broken pieces whole, and its fierce stomach acid dissolves them.
The meal nobody else can eat is the one nobody can steal.

description:
The bearded vulture (lammergeier) lives almost entirely on bone: 85 to 90 percent of its diet.
It drops bones too large to swallow onto rocks from great heights (sources give up to about 100 m), then swallows the shards whole and digests them with extremely acidic stomach juices. It also stains its white feathers rusty orange by bathing in iron-rich mud.
Which animal has the strangest diet you know?
first_comment: Up to 90% bone. Which animal would you least want to share a meal with?
